name: What are the benefits of choosing high-pressure drain jetting over traditional snaking?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing high-pressure drain jetting over traditional snaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-pressure drain jetting offers several advantages over traditional snaking. While snaking can puncture a hole through a blockage, jetting thoroughly cleans the entire circumference of the pipe, removing accumulated grease, scale, and other debris that can cause future clogs. This results in a more lasting solution and improved flow. For challenging issues like extensive root intrusion or heavy sludge, jetting is often more effective, especially for preventative maintenance to keep pipes clear for longer periods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drain jetting cleans the entire pipe, removing all debris for a more lasting solution and improved flow, whereas snaking only punctures a hole through blockages. It's more effective for severe clogs and preventative maintenance.
